notes.title: Thief And Mafia System
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-lHJV3kBapQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Your store is now the target of criminals, and how you protect it is entirely up to you.[/b]

[b]🔫 Thieves Come for Your Cash[/b]
Thieves enter your shop with weapons in hand and walk straight to the cash register.
If you haven’t installed an alarm or security camera, they’ll take your money and walk right out.

[b]😨 Upgrade Your Security[/b]
Alarm System sounds the moment a thief enters. Sometimes, that’s enough to make them turn around and leave.
Security Cameras increase their chance of backing off the moment they step in.

[b]👮‍♂️ Level 3 Security: Guard at the Door[/b]
Once you hire a guard, thieves stop showing up.
But now, a new kind of threat arrives.

[b]💼 The Mafia Takes Interest[/b]
When your store becomes too secure for ordinary thieves, the mafia starts showing up instead.
Alarms, cameras, and guards don’t stop them. Everyone’s too afraid to intervene.
They come in armed and take your money just like the thieves, but with no hesitation.

[b]🔫 Level 4 Security: Mafia vs Mafia[/b]
Your only defense is to make a deal with another mafia group.
At Level 4 security, two armed mafia guards will stand at your door protecting your store from rival gangs.

[b]Will your store survive the chaos?[/b]

[h3]Additionally, the issue with mouse sensitivity settings not being saved has been fixed.
[/h3]

[h2]More updates will come in the future. Thanks for playing.
[/h2]

notes.title: Game Name Changed + Visual Adjustments
notes.content:
The game’s name has been changed. In-game visuals such as logos and text have also been updated to match the new name. There are no changes to gameplay in this update.

[b][h3]⚠️ Important Note About Customer Issue After the Update[/h3][/b]

Some players have reported that no customers are entering the store after the latest update. This issue is most likely caused by the installation folder name changing due to the update.

[b][h3]✅ Solution:[/h3][/b]
Please try uninstalling and reinstalling the game. This will reset the installation folder name properly and fix the issue. After doing this, customers should enter the store and make purchases as expected.

I sincerely apologize for this inconvenience. As a solo developer working on my first simulator game, I truly appreciate your patience and support. Thank you for being part of this journey!

[h3]Join Us:[/h3]
https://discord.gg/EzHwpCyNZX


[h2][b]More updates will come in the future. Thanks for playing.[/b][/h2]
